market.headline: Golar LNG Limited Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
market.summary: Golar LNG Limited has declared a cash dividend of $0.25 per share for the third quarter of 2026, payable on December 9, 2026.

market.headline: Golar LNG Limited Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
market.summary: Golar LNG Limited announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results, reporting net income of $23 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $56 million.

market.headline: Deutsche Bank Raises Price Target on TransDigm Group
market.summary: Deutsche Bank has increased its price target for TransDigm Group Incorporated from $1,163 to $1,305 while maintaining a 'Hold' rating.

market.headline: Volkswagen Announces New Virtus Sedan for Indian Market
market.summary: Volkswagen India is set to launch the 'New Virtus,' a refreshed version of its premium sedan featuring updated design elements inspired by triangular geometry.

market.headline: Volkswagen and Stellantis Reportedly Considering Partnership with Hongqi
market.summary: Reports indicate that Volkswagen and Stellantis may be exploring potential partnerships with Chinese automaker Hongqi for production within Europe.

market.headline: HSBC Initiates Coverage on INNIO with Buy Rating
market.summary: HSBC has initiated coverage on INNIO N.V. with a Buy rating and a price target of $20.

market.headline: Nippon Yusen K.K. Unveils Ammonia-Fueled Vessel 'Izanami' for Charter to Yara
market.summary: Nippon Yusen K.K. (NYK Line) has unveiled the ammonia-fueled vessel 'Izanami', which is slated to be chartered by Yara upon its completion.

market.headline: Carlyle and KKR Commit Approximately $475 Million to Litmus Music
market.summary: Global investment firm KKR and Carlyle have committed approximately $475 million in new capital to music rights investment and management business Litmus Music.

market.headline: Argus Research Upgrades Elevance Health to Buy
market.summary: Argus Research has upgraded its rating on Elevance Health from "Hold" to "Buy."

market.headline: Mitsubishi Electric Signs First Commercial Launch Contract with PLD Space for MIURA 5
market.summary: Mitsubishi Electric has entered into its first commercial launch agreement with Spanish aerospace company PLD Space to utilize the MIURA 5 launch vehicle.

market.headline: Barclays Upgrades Vimian Group to Neutral
market.summary: Barclays has upgraded its rating for Vimian Group AB from underweight to neutral, while raising the price target to 41 SEK from 29 SEK.

market.headline: Safeture Enters Technology Partnership with Munich Re's Euro-Center
market.summary: Safeture has established a technology services partnership with Munich Re's Euro-Center to enhance its service offerings.

market.headline: Ardagh Metal Packaging Launches €1,250 Million Senior Secured Floating Rate Green Notes Offering
market.summary: Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. has announced the launch of a €1,250 million senior secured floating rate green notes offering to refinance existing debt and support general corporate purposes.

market.headline: Virbac to Participate in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
market.summary: Virbac announced that its CEO and Group CFO will participate in a company presentation and Q&A session at the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London.

market.headline: Skanska Commissions Eqva Subsidiary for Norsk Hydro Project
market.summary: Skanska has engaged a subsidiary of Eqva ASA to perform technical installations at a planned facility for Norsk Hydro.

market.headline: Vusion Unveils 2030 Strategic Growth Plan
market.summary: Vusion has announced a new strategic plan targeting 3 billion euros in revenue by 2030, alongside a downward revision of its 2027 revenue target.

market.headline: Verallia Announces “Verallia Beyond – From Resilience to Acceleration” Strategic Plan
market.summary: Verallia has unveiled its new strategic plan, "Verallia Beyond – From Resilience to Acceleration," during its 2026 Capital Markets Day.

market.headline: Eni's Plenitude Secures Power Purchase Agreement with Orva
market.summary: Eni's subsidiary, Plenitude, has entered into a four-year power purchase agreement (PPA) with the Italian food company Orva to supply 16 GWh of energy.

market.headline: Mycronic Wins US Photomask Repair System Order
market.summary: Mycronic has secured an order for a photomask repair system in the United States valued at up to $3 million.

market.headline: Capgemini Executive Surbhi Dhir Recognized at 2026 Stevie Awards for Women in Business
market.summary: Surbhi Dhir, Head of Financial Services, Banking and Capital Markets at Capgemini, was named a winner at the 2026 Stevie Awards for Women in Business.

market.headline: Scotiabank Partners with Casa for Condominium Payment Rewards
market.summary: Scotiabank has entered a partnership with Casa, allowing ScotiaGold Passport Visa cardholders to earn rewards on condominium payments.

market.headline: BofA Raises Ferrari Price Objective Amid Strong FY27 Visibility
market.summary: Bank of America has increased its price target for Ferrari from 395 to 410 euros, citing strong visibility for the 2027 fiscal year.

market.headline: BNP Paribas Announces Strategic Repositioning of Italian Subsidiary BNL
market.summary: BNP Paribas has unveiled a new strategic plan for its Italian banking arm, BNL, which includes a 20% reduction in branch count by 2030 and a target to achieve a pre-tax return on allocated capital (RONE) exceeding 20%.

market.headline: EQT Reportedly Considering Sale of Indira IVF Hospital
market.summary: EQT AB is reportedly exploring a potential divestiture of its majority-owned Indian fertility clinic chain, Indira IVF Hospital.

market.headline: Berenberg Trims Fresenius Medical Care Estimates and Price Target
market.summary: Berenberg analysts have lowered their financial estimates and price target for Fresenius Medical Care, citing anticipated headwinds for the 2027 fiscal year while maintaining a 'Hold' rating.

market.headline: BMW and E.ON Expand Bidirectional Charging Partnership
market.summary: BMW and E.ON have announced the expansion of their bidirectional charging technology to three additional electric vehicle models.

market.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for The Walt Disney Company
market.summary: Multiple financial institutions, including Raymond James, Needham, and Barclays, updated their price targets for The Walt Disney Company on November 18, 2026.

market.headline: Barclays Upgrades Sonova Rating to 'Overweight'
market.summary: Barclays has upgraded its rating for Sonova Holding AG from 'Underweight' to 'Overweight', contributing to a rise in the company's share price.

market.headline: Insider Sale of Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group Shares
market.summary: Arihiro Nagata, a Senior Managing Corporate Executive Officer at Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group, sold 46,000 shares of the company.

market.headline: Sectra to Showcase AI-Integrated Diagnostic Tools at RSNA 2026
market.summary: Sectra announced it will demonstrate its latest medical imaging IT solutions, featuring integrated AI for autonomous workflows and enhanced clinical tools, at the RSNA 2026 conference.

market.headline: Interparfums Named in Legal Dispute Between Coty and DB Ventures
market.summary: Interparfums is identified as the incoming licensee for David Beckham fragrances in a legal dispute between Coty and DB Ventures regarding sales channels and contract termination.

market.headline: Exor's Investment Value in Stellantis Declines
market.summary: Exor has experienced a significant decline in the market value of its stake in Stellantis, with losses exceeding 2.8 billion euros since the beginning of 2026.

market.headline: Kepler Cheuvreux Raises Novonesis Price Target to 550 DKK
market.summary: Analyst firm Kepler Cheuvreux has increased its price target for Novonesis to 550 DKK from 525 DKK while maintaining a 'buy' rating.

market.headline: Raymond James Adjusts Price Target on Ecolab to $385
market.summary: Raymond James has increased its price target for Ecolab Inc. from $300 to $385.

market.headline: F2i Enters Exclusivity Agreement with Snam Regarding Bioenerys Agri
market.summary: F2i has entered into an exclusivity agreement with Snam concerning the biomethane platform Bioenerys Agri as part of its latest investment cycle.

market.headline: SGS Expands Packaging Testing Capabilities at Bentonville Laboratory
market.summary: SGS has expanded its ISTA (International Safe Transit Association) packaging testing services at its laboratory in Bentonville, Arkansas, to support manufacturers and retailers in optimizing package performance and supply chain efficiency.

market.headline: Autoliv Receives 2026 Automotive News PACE Pilot Recognition for Omni Safety™
market.summary: Autoliv, Inc. has been recognized in the 2026 Automotive News PACE Pilot program for its innovative mobility safety solution, Omni Safety™.

market.headline: Bernstein Initiates Coverage on Tokyo Electron with 'Outperform' Rating
market.summary: Bernstein has assigned an 'Outperform' rating to Tokyo Electron Limited, setting a price target of ¥16,300.

market.headline: ACL Digital, part of the ALTEN Group, launches SHIFTAIon
market.summary: ACL Digital, a subsidiary of the ALTEN Group, has introduced SHIFTAIon, an AI-driven migration factory designed to assist enterprises in modernizing and transforming their application estates.

market.headline: Drägerwerk Announces Strategic Growth Targets for 2030
market.summary: Drägerwerk AG & Co. KGaA has unveiled its mid-term strategic goals, targeting 4.5 billion euros in revenue and an EBIT margin of 10 to 12 percent by 2030.

market.headline: Barclays Maintains Hold Rating on Klarna Group
market.summary: Barclays analyst Nik Cremo maintained a hold rating on Klarna Group while adjusting the price target from $20 to $16.

market.headline: TORM plc Rejects Unsolicited Combination Proposals from Hafnia Limited
market.summary: TORM plc announced that its Board of Directors has unanimously rejected multiple all-share combination proposals from Hafnia Limited, citing that the offers substantially undervalued the company.

market.headline: Banco BPM Launches New '12+ Fixed Premium' Certificates
market.summary: Banco BPM has listed a new tranche of nine '12+ Fixed Premium' certificates on the Cert-X market, featuring a three-year maturity with an early redemption option after the first year.

market.headline: Barclays Revises 2027 Estimates for Insurance Sector
market.summary: Barclays has updated its 2027 earnings estimates for the insurance sector, maintaining a positive outlook on Unipol while downgrading other industry peers.

market.headline: Barclays Adjusts Price Target for Elekta
market.summary: Barclays has updated its price target for Elekta, raising it to 49.50 SEK from 45.50 SEK while maintaining an underweight rating.

market.headline: OMERS and Blackstone-Backed Transmission Developers Form Partnership for Toronto Third Line Project
market.summary: OMERS and Transmission Developers Infrastructure (TDI), a Blackstone portfolio company, have partnered to bid on the Independent Electricity System Operator's Toronto Third Line procurement.

market.headline: BioArctic Announces Date for Third Quarter 2026 Financial Report
market.summary: BioArctic AB has scheduled the release of its financial report for the third quarter of 2026 for November 25, 2026, followed by an investor webcast.

market.headline: Exail Technologies Secures New US Orders for DriX Surface Drones
market.summary: Exail Technologies has announced the receipt of new orders for five autonomous surface drones in the United States, valued at several tens of millions of euros.

market.headline: Airtel Money Enhances Payment Experience in Malawi and Tanzania with Comviva Partnership
market.summary: Airtel Money has integrated Comviva's mobiquity Pay platform to improve digital transaction speeds and user experience for customers in Malawi and Tanzania.

market.headline: Volvo Cars Joins Microsoft's AI Transparency Initiative
market.summary: Volvo Cars is collaborating with Microsoft and over 40 other organizations to develop open, industry-wide standards for AI transparency, safety, and governance.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA Faces SEC Investigation and Delays Quarterly 10-Q Filing
NVDA.summary: Following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang, NVIDIA is under SEC investigation and has delayed its quarterly 10-Q filing.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA Co-Founder Jensen Huang Retains Director Nomination Rights
NVDA.summary: NVIDIA co-founder Jensen Huang retains the right to nominate two directors to the company's board.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA Establishes Export Control Committee and Delays 10-Q Filing
NVDA.summary: NVIDIA has formed a new oversight committee for national security and export controls while delaying its quarterly 10-Q filing.

NVDA.headline: NVIDIA Reports Financial Results for Third Quarter Fiscal 2027
NVDA.summary: NVIDIA announced its financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2027, reporting revenue of $115.8 billion, a 103% increase year-over-year.

MSFT.headline: StackGen Launches Shipyard on Microsoft Marketplace
MSFT.summary: StackGen has made its Shipyard platform available on the Microsoft Marketplace, enabling Azure customers to deploy ephemeral test environments for AI agents and developers.

AAPL.headline: Apple Services Experience Outage Following Internal Update
AAPL.summary: Apple experienced a widespread service outage on November 18, 2026, impacting the App Store, iCloud, and internal employee systems due to an internal update.

AAPL.headline: South Korean Regulator Orders Apple to Designate Legal Representatives
AAPL.summary: South Korean regulators have ordered Apple and several other major technology companies to appoint local legal representatives by January following a rise in customer complaints.

AAPL.headline: Apple Updates Operating System to Restrict Accessibility Tool Usage
AAPL.summary: Apple has implemented an operating system update that restricts the use of accessibility tools on Macs to prevent potential data privacy risks.

AAPL.headline: Apple Reports Widespread Internal and Consumer Service Outages
AAPL.summary: Apple experienced significant service disruptions affecting internal corporate tools, retail store operations, and consumer-facing services.

AMZN.headline: Jeff Bezos Discusses Casting Process for New James Bond Film
AMZN.summary: Amazon executive chairman Jeff Bezos provided insights into the casting of Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond, confirming the role of Amazon MGM Studios in the selection process.

AMZN.headline: Transamerica Expands AI Partnership with Amazon Web Services
AMZN.summary: Transamerica has deepened its collaboration with Amazon Web Services to scale artificial intelligence across its enterprise operations.

AMZN.headline: Teamsters Rally Following Amazon's Termination of Delivery Partner
AMZN.summary: The International Brotherhood of Teamsters held a rally in Manhattan to protest the firing of approximately 200 delivery drivers following Amazon's cancellation of a contract with a delivery service partner.

AVGO.headline: Broadcom to Invest $1 Billion in Anthropic IPO
AVGO.summary: Broadcom has agreed to invest $1 billion in Anthropic's initial public offering as part of a strategic commitment involving major technology suppliers.

META.headline: Meta Platforms COO Javier Olivan Sells Shares Worth Over $1 Million
META.summary: Meta Platforms Chief Operating Officer Javier Olivan sold 1,568 shares of company stock, according to a recent SEC Form 4 filing.

META.headline: Meta Testing Standalone Messaging App 'Direct'
META.summary: Meta has begun testing a standalone messaging app called 'Direct' in Thailand and Turkey, allowing users to access Instagram messages without an Instagram account.

TSLA.headline: Barclays Maintains Tesla Buy Rating
TSLA.summary: Barclays has reaffirmed its 'Buy' rating for Tesla, Inc. and maintained a price target of $450.

TSLA.headline: Tesla Receives Analyst Downgrade to Sell
TSLA.summary: Tesla has been downgraded to a 'Sell' rating by analyst Gil Rotsein, citing concerns over the company's valuation and profitability.

TSLA.headline: Tesla Urges Shareholder Participation for 2026 Annual Meeting
TSLA.summary: Tesla has initiated a proxy solicitation campaign, urging shareholders to vote on board recommendations ahead of the company's 2026 Annual Meeting scheduled for December 3.

TTWO.headline: Take-Two's Rockstar Games Promoting 'GTA VI' in China Despite Lack of Approval
TTWO.summary: Rockstar Games is reportedly promoting its upcoming title 'Grand Theft Auto VI' in China, despite the game not having received the necessary official sales approval in the region.

TJX.headline: The TJX Companies, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
TJX.summary: The TJX Companies, Inc. announced its financial results for the third quarter ended October 31, 2026, reporting net sales of $16.0 billion and a 4% increase in consolidated comparable sales.

COHR.headline: Coherent Corp. CEO and Chairman Purchase Shares
COHR.summary: Coherent Corp. leadership, including the CEO and Chairman, have acquired company shares, leading to the stock being named a 'pick of the week' by Smart Insider.

CRDO.headline: Credo Technology Group Holding Reaches Patent Agreement With Marvell
CRDO.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd. has entered into a patent settlement agreement with Marvell Technology regarding Active Electrical Cable (AEC) technology.

BE.headline: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC Initiates Investigation into Bloom Energy
BE.summary: Law firm Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has announced an investigation into potential corporate wrongdoing at Bloom Energy Corporation.

LOW.headline: Lowe's Reports Q3 2026 Financial Results
LOW.summary: Lowe's Companies, Inc. reported third-quarter revenue of $22.76 billion and adjusted earnings per share of $3.10, both exceeding analyst expectations.

FCX.headline: PT Freeport Indonesia Prices $750 Million Senior Notes Offering
FCX.summary: PT Freeport Indonesia, an affiliate 48.76% owned by Freeport-McMoRan, has agreed to sell $750 million in senior notes due 2033 to refinance existing debt.

MDLN.headline: Medline's Stockholders Price 60 Million Shares at $35.50 Each
MDLN.summary: Medline stockholders have priced a secondary offering of 60 million shares at $35.50 per share.

NKE.headline: Nike Targets 50% Local Product Creation in China by Fiscal 2030
NKE.summary: Nike announced a new initiative to design and create half of its sportswear products locally in China by fiscal 2030.
